column1: # What every sound label in a PORTED move's script becomes on Rat of Doom.
#   donor label<TAB>label Rat of Doom plays     ("-" drops the call)
# Read by tools/extract-sounds.awk while tools/gen-moves.sh emits each ported move's `sound_`
# script. Lower case, as the scripts spell them. A donor label with no row here is DROPPED and the
# generator lists it, so a gap is visible rather than silent; `se_common_*`, `se_pikachu_*`,
#   * a donor sound whose audio now sits in one of Pikachu's entries (tools/sound-slots.tsv) --
#     the label is rewritten to that entry's;
#   * a donor MOVEMENT sound inside a borrowed move (a step, a landing, a dash start, a dodge) --
#     rewritten to Pikachu's own equivalent, because those are his feet and his landings;
#   * a donor VOICE line -- rewritten to Pikachu's own voice, so Rat of Doom keeps Pikachu's
#     voice everywhere. Random voice sequences become his `seq_pikachu_rnd_attack`.
# special_l01 is the counter stance, started by HIS status code; the script only STOPs it, and
# nothing on Rat of Doom starts it, so the stop is dropped.
# ---- every donor's random attack voice becomes Pikachu's ----
